project.name: Example niche SaaS
project.description: Synthetic example for demonstrating the assessment contract.

positive_factors: Five target buyers described the recurring manual cost
unknowns: Cost of inaction across the segment
problem.rationale: The problem appears real but payment behavior is not verified.

positive_factors: User and buyer roles are named
customer.rationale: The ICP is specific enough for a pilot but procurement remains unknown.

positive_factors: A list of 300 matching accounts is available
market.rationale: Reach is tangible but the effective market is not established.

negative_factors: A bundled incumbent feature may be sufficient
competition.rationale: There is room to improve the workflow, but switching value needs proof.

negative_factors: Feature set is easy to copy
differentiation.rationale: Initial relevance exists without a strong moat.

positive_factors: Concierge process can deliver the core outcome
product.rationale: A pilot is deliverable, but product maturity is intentionally low.

positive_factors: A value-based monthly price hypothesis exists
negative_factors: No payment request has been made
monetization.rationale: Pricing is a testable assumption, not evidence.

positive_factors: Founder has direct access to 40 target buyers
acquisition.rationale: The first ten buyers are reachable, but scale is unproven.

positive_factors: Expected variable software cost is low
negative_factors: Support time, CAC, and churn are unknown
economics.rationale: Economics cannot yet support a production investment.

positive_factors: Pilot needs no regulated data or complex integration
execution_risk.rationale: The next experiment is feasible within constraints.

positive_factors: Founder has domain access and enough hours for a pilot
negative_factors: No dedicated sales capacity beyond the founder
founder_fit.rationale: Fit is strong for validation, not yet for scale.

evidence.label: EVIDENCE
evidence.statement: Five synthetic interview summaries describe the problem.
evidence.limitations: Small convenience sample and no payment behavior.

evidence.label: FACT
evidence.statement: A synthetic list contains 300 matching accounts and 40 founder contacts.
evidence.limitations: Reachability does not prove need or conversion.

evidence.label: ESTIMATE
evidence.statement: A concierge pilot can be delivered within 60 hours and USD 1,000.

unknowns.item: Willingness to pay USD 500 per month
unknowns.resolution: Request three paid pilot commitments from qualified buyers.

assumptions.sensitivity: Below USD 300, founder delivery time may make the model unattractive.

attacks.challenged_claim: Interview interest implies willingness to pay.
attacks.failure_mechanism: Polite interview responses may disappear when payment is requested.
attacks.falsification_test: Secure three paid pilots at or above USD 500 per month.

experiments.hypothesis: Qualified buyers will pay USD 500 per month for the outcome.
experiments.method: Offer a four-week concierge pilot to 15 qualified accounts.
experiments.success_threshold: At least three signed and paid pilots.
experiments.failure_threshold: Zero paid pilots after 15 qualified offers.
experiments.cost: 60 founder hours and at most USD 1,000
experiments.decision_changed: Success permits building the minimum automation; failure triggers pricing or problem pivot.
